## Audit objectives

- [ ] Workflow/task state is consistent with GitHub Issue/PR history.
- [ ] Claim/evidence classifications are supported by referenced artifacts.
- [ ] Negative/falsifying/inconclusive results are preserved.
- [ ] Raw evidence is distinguishable from derived analysis.
- [ ] Reproduction command/environment is preserved where material.
- [ ] Migration status is explicit for historical work.
- [ ] No claim was promoted solely from task completion or chat summary.
